detailed_description: The Password Generator creates random passwords in the browser with configurable length and character groups. You can include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols, then copy the generated password. The current page uses the browser crypto API to fill random values and maps them into the selected character set. It is designed for quick password creation and examples. For account security, use a password manager to store unique passwords and follow the rules required by the service you are using.
usage_steps: Choose the password length with the slider.
Select the character groups you want to include.
Review the generated password shown at the top of the page.
Click Generate if you want a new password with the same settings.
Click Copy to place the password on your clipboard.
Save important passwords in a trusted password manager.
usage_examples: Generate a 16-character password with letters, numbers, and symbols.
Create a simpler password using letters and numbers only when a site rejects symbols.
Regenerate several options before choosing one to store.
Use the tool to demonstrate why longer passwords are harder to guess.

faqs.question: Which character groups can I include?
faqs.answer: You can include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.

faqs.question: What password lengths are available?
faqs.answer: The visible slider supports lengths from 8 to 64 characters.

faqs.question: What happens if I turn off every character group?
faqs.answer: The page asks you to select at least one option before it can generate a password.

faqs.question: Should I reuse generated passwords?
faqs.answer: No. Use unique passwords for important accounts and store them in a password manager.

faqs.question: Does copying a password have risks?
faqs.answer: Clipboard contents may be visible to other apps or users on the device, so clear or replace the clipboard when needed.
